draft.subject: Re: Inviting a teammate
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Glad the first project is starting to click -- thanks for saying so.

On your question: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time. If you have several people to add, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Your ticket about this is still open with Tariq, so you'll hear back there too.

If it's easier, I'm happy to walk through adding your first teammate on a short call this week -- just name a time that suits you.

Best,
Nadia
